args.query: blink an LED and read a push button on Raspberry Pi with gpiozero

results.title: web-push VAPID keys and aes128gcm payload encryption, verified offline
results.summary: Generate VAPID keys and the exact push-service request with web-push (no send), then decrypt the aes128gcm payload as the browser would with http_ece and verify the ES256 VAPID JWT with node:crypto.

results.title: pandas to_sql and read_sql with a SQLAlchemy 2 engine on sqlite, with dtype handling
results.summary: Write and read DataFrames through a SQLAlchemy 2 engine, control column types with dtype, and handle datetimes and nullable ints, tested offline on in-memory sqlite.

results.title: clsx, tailwind-merge and CVA button variants
results.summary: Compose class names with clsx, resolve Tailwind conflicts via tailwind-merge, and define button variants with class-variance-authority.

results.title: pandas DataFrame to formatted Excel report with openpyxl styles and roundtrip read
results.summary: Write a DataFrame to a styled .xlsx with openpyxl (header styles, number formats, widths, freeze panes, filters), then read it back with pandas and verify, fully offline.

results.title: Excel .xlsx export and import with ExcelJS
results.summary: Generate styled .xlsx reports (header row, number formats, formulas, frozen panes) and read uploaded workbooks back into typed rows with ExcelJS, all in memory.

results.title: polib PO catalog read, edit and write roundtrip with MO compile
results.summary: Read, edit and write gettext PO catalogs with polib, compile them to MO, and audit fuzzy and untranslated entries fully offline.

results.title: Django post_save signal enqueuing a Celery task, tested with eager mode and on_commit
results.summary: A post_save signal queues a Celery task only after the row commits via transaction.on_commit, then tests run offline on in-memory SQLite with Celery eager mode and pytest-django's on_commit capture.

results.title: Elysia API with TypeBox validation and guards, tested via app.handle on Node
results.summary: An Elysia 1.4 app with TypeBox schemas for params, query, body and responses, a guard with an API key check and custom error mapping, tested on Node with web-standard Request objects through app.handle and no open port.

results.title: Litestar app with advanced-alchemy and DTOs on SQLite
results.summary: A Litestar app wired to SQLAlchemy through the advanced-alchemy plugin, with separate read and write DTOs over aiosqlite, tested offline with litestar.testing TestClient.

results.title: Async repository pattern with SQLAlchemy 2 AsyncSession on aiosqlite
results.summary: A typed async repository over SQLAlchemy 2 AsyncSession with eager loading, foreign keys enforced on SQLite, and offline pytest-asyncio tests against an in-memory database.
